newsitem.title: USA: Imo Q1 profit restated as $12.8 mln loss.
newsitem.headline: Imo Q1 profit restated as $12.8 mln loss.

text.p: Imo Industries Inc said Wednesday that it has restated earnings for the first quarter, ended March 31, reporting a loss of $12.8 million instead of a profit of $1.1. million.

The company said it took the action as a result of a judgment entered against it by the US District Court for the Northern District of California in connection with a 1985 dispute with its insurer, International Insurance Co, and the Long Island Lighting Co.

As Imo reported on May 9, the court reinstated a previously vacated judgment in favor of International Insurance with a new judgement for about $12.9 million, which includes interest to date of approximately $1.7 million.
The company said the judgment and interest have subsequently been recorded as a charge to income in the first quarter of 1997.
The company said it is reviewing various options available to it, including legal appeal and settlement discussions with International.
Imo, with 1996 sales of $469 million, is a manufacturer of pumps, fluid sensors, motion control products, remote control systems and automotive components, with operations worldwide.
